instrument_overhead.method: mean(on)-mean(off) + t(0.95, Welch df) * sqrt(var_on/n_on + var_off/n_off); on = null_handler samples, unbiased under random 1 ms clock phase

missed_refresh.method: warm: trials with >=1 missed refresh, editor vs NULL (recording hooks on); one-sided Fisher exact test, H1 editor proportion > NULL proportion, fail if p < 0.05; cold (diagnostic, not gating): fresh processes with a missed refresh besides one pause <=70 ms (first preview presentation)
